rubric_content.text_property: When a query fails, the agent must read the database error it was given and change the specific thing the error identifies. Penalize resending an unchanged query, guessing at a new name without consulting the schema, or abandoning the task while a correctable error is outstanding.

Every figure in the final answer must come from a successful query result. Penalize any number that was not returned by the tool, and penalize presenting an answer as fact when all query attempts failed.

sql_result_match.description: 1.0 when re-running the agent's final SQL returns the expected rows. Compares result sets rather than query text, because many spellings of a query are correct and only the rows settle it.

sql_self_heal_recovery.description: Among invocations whose first query failed, the share that went on to run a successful one. Invocations that never failed are skipped, so padding the dataset with easy queries cannot inflate the score.
